changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE quote_edp_results RENAME TO quote_edp_results_old; CREATE TABLE quote_edp_results ( id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), quote_id INT NOT NULL, edp_id INT NOT NULL, edp_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, edp_type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, levy_gbp_min DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, levy_gbp_max DECIMAL(12, 2) NOT NULL, impact JSONB NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT fk_quote_edp_results_quote_id FOREIGN KEY (quote_id) REFERENCES quotes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); DROP TABLE quote_edp_results_old;
